variants.headline: Accident at a workplace
variants.sub: The colony has had an accident at a workplace.
variants.body:
An accident has occurred at a workplace in {colony}. The occurrence is established, while a particular injury or legal finding is not supplied here. Readers considering {target} should distinguish scrutiny of safety responsibility from an invented account of the accident's cause or the condition of those involved.

An accident at work. A plain statement, and a reason to remember that a workplace is full of people rather than merely output. No lurid description is needed. Readers deserve attention to safety without being sold an injury, a culprit or a scene that this report does not establish.

We criticise {target} on the standard of safety stewardship. An accident warrants serious questions about responsibility, rather than a comfortable presumption that the conduct surrounding work should remain beyond public judgment. Readers deserve a clear story and a straight answer about responsibility.
